author: Michael Jensen
citation: Not long after, John and I laid out in our sleeping bags. Behind us in the dunes, the penguins chattered away, deep into the night.
location: Hidden cove near Twelve Apostles, Great Ocean Road, Victoria, Australia
provenance: Personal testimony published in LGBTQ Nation, recounting November 1987 night spent in sleeping bags directly on the sand of a secluded beach with a fairy penguin colony.
